release.name: Triton Ascend 3.2.1 release
release.body:
# Release Notes

This release enhances support for Triton 3.2.0, supporting 950PR basic functionality.

## Version Compatibility

Supported Ascend Hardware and Software Environments:

- CANN: 9.0.0
- PyTorch: 2.7.1, 2.8.0, 2.9.1, 2.10.0
- Python: 3.9 (X86 only) / 3.10 / 3.11 / 3.12 / 3.13
- Ascend Hardware: Atlas 800 A2 series / Atlas 800 A3 / 950PR series

## New Features

### Feature Enhancements

- Supports 111 basic triton op functions (950PR)
- AutoTune (trial version) supports automatic optimization (supports Vector class operators, no configuration required)
- Supports debugging and tuning tools such as msprof, msOpProf, and Interpreter

### Bug Fixes

- Fixed boundary checks, mask analysis, and ifOp parsing issues in TritonToUnstructure/TritonToLinalg/TritonToStructured conversions
- Fixed driver memory allocation issues
- Fixed unsigned/signed Type conversion and overflow handling.
- Fixed support for fp8, bf16, and half types in dot/cast/pow operations.- 
- Fixed exception handling for multi-threaded and asynchronous compilation.
- Fixed installation overwrite issue between Triton and Triton-Ascend.

Full changelog: https://github.com/triton-lang/triton-ascend/compare/v3.2.0...v3.2.1
